title: PX to REM Toolkit configuration (.pxtoremrc.json)
description: Project settings for the PX to REM Toolkit VS Code extension and the px-to-rem CLI.

format.description: Output for converted values. Presets: auto (uses your rem() function in preprocessor files when the project defines one, otherwise 1rem), rem (1rem), rem-function (rem(16)), rem-function-px (rem(16px)), em, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, rpx, pt. Or a template with {rem}, {px}, {em}, {vw}, {vh}, {vmin}, {vmax}, {rpx}, {pt} and {fn} (the function name), e.g. toRem({px}).
format.markdownDescription: Output for converted values. Presets: `auto` (uses your `rem()` function in preprocessor files when the project defines one, otherwise `1rem`), `rem` (`1rem`), `rem-function` (`rem(16)`), `rem-function-px` (`rem(16px)`), `em`, `vw`, `vh`, `vmin`, `vmax`, `rpx`, `pt`. Or a template with `{rem}`, `{px}`, `{em}`, `{vw}`, `{vh}`, `{vmin}`, `{vmax}`, `{rpx}`, `{pt}` and `{fn}` (the function name), e.g. `toRem({px})`.

functionName.description: Name of your px-to-rem function, used by the function formats, reverse conversion and helper generation.
functionName.markdownDescription: Name of your px-to-rem function, used by the function formats, reverse conversion and helper generation.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Pick the best unit per property: font sizes and spacing become rem, line-height becomes unitless, letter-spacing becomes em, borders and shadows stay px, media queries become em.
Convert every px value with the same format.

baseFontSize.description: Root font size in px (1rem). Used when detection is off or finds nothing.
baseFontSize.markdownDescription: Root font size in px (1rem). Used when detection is off or finds nothing.

baseFontSizeDetection.description: Detect the root font size from the project.
baseFontSizeDetection.markdownDescription: Detect the root font size from the project.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Read the root font size from `html`/`:root` rules (e.g. `font-size: 62.5%` → 10px) or a postcss-pxtorem `rootValue`, unless `baseFontSize` is set explicitly.
Always use `baseFontSize`.

precision.description: Maximum number of decimal places in generated values.
precision.markdownDescription: Maximum number of decimal places in generated values.

minValue.description: Smallest absolute px value to convert (e.g. 2 keeps 1px).
minValue.markdownDescription: Smallest absolute px value to convert (e.g. 2 keeps 1px).

maxValue.description: Largest absolute px value to convert.
maxValue.markdownDescription: Largest absolute px value to convert.

includeProperties.description: Only convert these properties (globs such as padding* work). Empty means all.
includeProperties.markdownDescription: Only convert these properties (globs such as `padding*` work). Empty means all.

excludeProperties.description: Never convert these properties (globs such as border* work).
excludeProperties.markdownDescription: Never convert these properties (globs such as `border*` work).

excludePatterns.description: Regular expressions; lines that match are left alone. Prefer /* px-to-rem-disable-next-line */ comments.
excludePatterns.markdownDescription: Regular expressions; lines that match are left alone. Prefer `/* px-to-rem-disable-next-line */` comments.

mediaQueries.description: What to do with px in @media and @container queries.
mediaQueries.markdownDescription: What to do with px in `@media` and `@container` queries.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Convert breakpoints to em (relative to the browser default, so they follow the user font size).
Convert breakpoints to rem (also relative to the browser default inside media queries).
Leave media and container queries alone.
Use `format` like everywhere else.

mediaQueryBase.description: Font size media queries are relative to. Browsers use their default (16px), not your html font size.
mediaQueryBase.markdownDescription: Font size media queries are relative to. Browsers use their default (16px), not your `html` font size.

interpolateInCalc.description: Wrap function output in #{} inside calc(), clamp(), min() and max() (Sass).
interpolateInCalc.markdownDescription: Wrap function output in `#{}` inside `calc()`, `clamp()`, `min()` and `max()` (Sass).

convertVariables.description: Convert values of Sass/Less/Stylus variables and CSS custom properties.
convertVariables.markdownDescription: Convert values of Sass/Less/Stylus variables and CSS custom properties.

convertMixinArguments.description: Convert px passed to mixins (@include size(16px)). Breakpoint mixins are never touched.
convertMixinArguments.markdownDescription: Convert px passed to mixins (`@include size(16px)`). Breakpoint mixins are never touched.

smartRules.description: Smart mode rules per property (globs allowed), merged over the defaults. Actions: convert (use format), rem, em (relative to the element font size), unitless (ratio to the element font size), keep. Defaults: {"font-size":"convert","line-height":"unitless","letter-spacing":"em","word-spacing":"em","border":"keep","border-width":"keep","border-*-width":"keep","border-top":"keep","border-right":"keep","border-bottom":"keep","border-left":"keep","border-block":"keep","border-block-start":"keep","border-block-end":"keep","border-inline":"keep","border-inline-start":"keep","border-inline-end":"keep","border-spacing":"convert","*-radius":"convert","outline":"keep","outline-width":"keep","outline-offset":"keep","box-shadow":"keep","text-shadow":"keep","column-rule":"keep","column-rule-width":"keep","stroke-width":"keep","-webkit-text-stroke":"keep","-webkit-text-stroke-width":"keep","filter":"keep","backdrop-filter":"keep","text-decoration-thickness":"em","text-underline-offset":"em"}
smartRules.markdownDescription: Smart mode rules per property (globs allowed), merged over the defaults. Actions: `convert` (use `format`), `rem`, `em` (relative to the element font size), `unitless` (ratio to the element font size), `keep`.

hairline.description: Smart mode keeps values up to this many px as px (hairlines, 1px nudges). 0 turns it off.
hairline.markdownDescription: Smart mode keeps values up to this many px as px (hairlines, 1px nudges). 0 turns it off.

designWidth.description: Design viewport width in px, for vw, vmin, vmax and rpx.
designWidth.markdownDescription: Design viewport width in px, for vw, vmin, vmax and rpx.

designHeight.description: Design viewport height in px, for vh, vmin and vmax.
designHeight.markdownDescription: Design viewport height in px, for vh, vmin and vmax.

reverseUnits.description: What "Convert back to px" rewrites: rem, em, vw, vh, vmin, vmax, rpx, pt and function (rem(16)).
reverseUnits.markdownDescription: What "Convert back to px" rewrites: `rem`, `em`, `vw`, `vh`, `vmin`, `vmax`, `rpx`, `pt` and `function` (`rem(16)`).

minViewport.description: Smallest viewport width for fluid clamp() values.
minViewport.markdownDescription: Smallest viewport width for fluid `clamp()` values.

maxViewport.description: Largest viewport width for fluid clamp() values.
maxViewport.markdownDescription: Largest viewport width for fluid `clamp()` values.

breakpoints.description: Viewport widths shown when explaining clamp(), calc(), min() and max().
breakpoints.markdownDescription: Viewport widths shown when explaining `clamp()`, `calc()`, `min()` and `max()`.

unit.description: Unit that makes generated clamp() values fluid.
unit.markdownDescription: Unit that makes generated `clamp()` values fluid.
markdownEnumDescriptions: Scale with the viewport.
Scale with the nearest container (container query units).

checkZoom.description: Check fluid font sizes against WCAG 1.4.4 (text must reach 200% with browser zoom).
checkZoom.markdownDescription: Check fluid font sizes against WCAG 1.4.4 (text must reach 200% with browser zoom).

enable.description: Use design tokens (CSS custom properties, Sass/Less/Stylus variables, token JSON files) for snapping, hovers and quick fixes.
enable.markdownDescription: Use design tokens (CSS custom properties, Sass/Less/Stylus variables, token JSON files) for snapping, hovers and quick fixes.

sources.description: Files or globs that define tokens (.css, .scss, .less, .styl, DTCG/Tokens Studio/Style Dictionary .json). Empty means auto-detect.
sources.markdownDescription: Files or globs that define tokens (`.css`, `.scss`, `.less`, `.styl`, DTCG/Tokens Studio/Style Dictionary `.json`). Empty means auto-detect.

autoDetect.description: Find tokens in the workspace when tokens.sources is empty.
autoDetect.markdownDescription: Find tokens in the workspace when `tokens.sources` is empty.

preferTokens.description: When a px value exactly matches a token, convert it to the token (e.g. var(--space-4)) instead of rem.
preferTokens.markdownDescription: When a px value exactly matches a token, convert it to the token (e.g. `var(--space-4)`) instead of rem.

reference.description: How tokens from JSON files are referenced in CSS. {name} is the token path joined with -.
reference.markdownDescription: How tokens from JSON files are referenced in CSS. `{name}` is the token path joined with `-`.

colors.description: Also match literal colours against colour tokens.
colors.markdownDescription: Also match literal colours against colour tokens.

colorTolerance.description: Maximum colour difference (CIEDE2000) for suggesting a nearby colour token. Around 2 is barely visible.
colorTolerance.markdownDescription: Maximum colour difference (CIEDE2000) for suggesting a nearby colour token. Around 2 is barely visible.

enable.description: Convert Tailwind arbitrary values such as p-[16px].
enable.markdownDescription: Convert Tailwind arbitrary values such as `p-[16px]`.
markdownEnumDescriptions: On when the project depends on Tailwind CSS.
Always on.
Off.

preferScale.description: Use the scale class when one matches (p-[16px] → p-4) instead of p-[1rem].
preferScale.markdownDescription: Use the scale class when one matches (`p-[16px]` → `p-4`) instead of `p-[1rem]`.

templateLiterals.description: Convert CSS in styled-components, emotion, Lit and Linaria templates.
templateLiterals.markdownDescription: Convert CSS in styled-components, emotion, Lit and Linaria templates.

objectStyles.description: Convert px strings in style objects ({ fontSize: '16px' }).
objectStyles.markdownDescription: Convert px strings in style objects (`{ fontSize: '16px' }`).

unitlessNumbers.description: Also convert numbers React treats as px ({ fontSize: 16 } → { fontSize: '1rem' }). Off by default; React Native projects never convert.
unitlessNumbers.markdownDescription: Also convert numbers React treats as px (`{ fontSize: 16 }` → `{ fontSize: '1rem' }`). Off by default; React Native projects never convert.

fileTypes.description: File extensions included in workspace conversion and statistics.
fileTypes.markdownDescription: File extensions included in workspace conversion and statistics.

excludeFiles.markdownDescription: Glob patterns for files to ignore (e.g. `**/*.min.css`, `**/vendor/**`). `node_modules` is always ignored.

respectGitignore.description: Skip files ignored by .gitignore in workspace operations.
respectGitignore.markdownDescription: Skip files ignored by `.gitignore` in workspace operations.

rules.description: Severity per rule, merged over the defaults. Rules: px-unit, font-size-px, line-height-px, letter-spacing-px, media-query-px, fixed-height-text, text-width-px, viewport-font-size, fluid-zoom, off-scale, off-palette, rem-function-missing.
rules.markdownDescription: Severity per rule, merged over the defaults. Rules: `px-unit`, `font-size-px`, `line-height-px`, `letter-spacing-px`, `media-query-px`, `fixed-height-text`, `text-width-px`, `viewport-font-size`, `fluid-zoom`, `off-scale`, `off-palette`, `rem-function-missing`.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Report everywhere.
Only report on lines changed since the last commit (git).
